#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cctype>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <functional>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MOD = 998244353;

ll modpow(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    if (b < 0) b = b % (mod - 1) + mod - 1;
    ll res = 1;
    a %= mod;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

// Fast input
class FastScanner {
public:
    FastScanner() : ptr(0), buflen(0) {
        // buffer already allocated
    }
    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < buflen) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        buflen = fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), stdin);
        return buflen > 0;
    }
    char readByte() {
        return hasNextByte() ? buffer[ptr++] : -1;
    }
    bool isPrintableChar(char c) {
        return 32 < c || c < 0;
    }
    bool isNumber(char c) {
        return '0' <= c && c <= '9';
    }
    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintableChar(buffer[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        if (!hasNext()) exit(1);
        long long n = 0;
        char b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            while (isNumber(b = readByte())) n = n * 10 + '0' - b;
            return n;
        } else if (!isNumber(b)) exit(1);
        do n = n * 10 + b - '0'; while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return (int)nextLong();
    }
private:
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr, buflen;
};

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    long long k = fs.nextLong();

    vector<ll> fact(n + 1), inv(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    inv[n] = modpow((int)fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;

    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> ll {
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
    };

    if (k == 0) {
        printf("%lld\n", fact[n]);
    } else if (k > n) {
        printf("0\n");
    } else {
        int k2 = (int)k;
        int k3 = n - k2;
        ll ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
            ll tmp = comb(k3, i) * modpow(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if ((k3 - i) & 1) ans = (ans - tmp + MOD) % MOD;
            else ans = (ans + tmp) % MOD;
        }
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
